steps.npc: Well, my intrepid friend, through those broken bars lies a most remarkable discovery! I named it Scurrius, The Rat King!
This is no ordinary rat. It is a magnificent creature of evolution, forged by the unwitting contributions of adventurers who entered its cave.
It absorbed their combat abilities, transforming itself into an obscene monster. Nature's response to intrusion, you might say! How utterly fascinating!
Ahem, anyway you'll be absolutely fine, of course! Your victory awaits, I'm sure. I shall observe your progress with interest... for science, you know.
Oh, and if you happen to come across Scurrius' spine, please bring it to me.

options.text: Can you tell me about Scurrius' spine?

steps.player: Excuse me, can you tell me about Scurrius' spine?

steps.npc: Of course! Scurrius spines are invaluable for my research.
I can use them to craft a potent bone weapon which will aid you when battling the Rat King.
Although you can create the weapons yourself, provided you have the required expertise and appropriate materials.
If you don't want a bone weapon, I can also trade you a lamp I found during my research expedition - one for every Scurrius spine you bring to me.

options.text: Can you make a bone weapon for me please?

steps.player: Can you make a bone weapon for me please?

steps.npc: You'll need to bring a Scurrius spine and either a Rune mace, a Yew shortbow, or a Battlestaff. An additional 1000 chaos runes are needed if you want to create a Bone staff.
I'll also charge 50,000 coins to craft the weapon.

steps.text: If the player does not have the materials in their inventory:

steps.npc: Come back when you have all the necessary materials.

steps.text: If the player does have the materials in their inventory:

steps.prompt: Which bone weapon do you want?

using-scurrius-spine-on-historian-aldo.npc: Ah, a Scurrius spine! A captivating subject indeed. I'll eagerly take them off your hands, and rest assured, you will be well rewarded.

right-click-trade-option.text: If the player does not have Scurrius' spine:

steps.npc: Ah, I'll need one of Scurrius' spines to do that. Perhaps you could fetch me one?

right-click-trade-option.text: If the player has Scurrius' spine:

steps.prompt: Trade Scurrius' spine for a combat lamp?

steps.text: Aldo gives you an Antique lamp for Scurrius' spine.

right-click-trade-option.text: If the player has Scurrius' spine and the materials to make a bone weapon:

steps.prompt: Trade your Scurrius spines for a bone weapon or combat lamp?
